description: Issue #841 (#841's original subject entity): EtlRunLog now implements ITenant with a new TenantCode column, populated from the owning EtlJobDefinition at every write site. This mutant deletes the ApplyEtlTenantFilter<EtlRunLog>(builder, context) call in ApplyEtlModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext), reproducing the pre-fix behaviour: a context scoped to tenant A can read tenant B's ETL run history (JobId, trigger, result, row counts, error messages, watermark snapshots) by id -- the exact hole #841 describes as making _EtlRunLogController's authorization gate meaningless no matter how the gate itself is fixed. Checked against EtlTenantIsolationTests.EtlRunLog_TenantA_CannotReadTenantB_Log, which seeds two EtlRunLog rows under two different tenants and asserts a context scoped to tenant A cannot resolve tenant B's row -- with the mutant applied, that read succeeds and the assertion fails. The green control, EtlRunLog_TenantA_CanReadOwnLog, asserts tenant A can still read its OWN run log, proving the mutation has no broader collateral effect on the EtlRunLogs table registration.

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.EtlTenantIsolat: #841/#862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlRunLog by GUID

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first; mutant patch applied via git apply, test run, then reverted via git apply -R): 'Assert.IsNull failed. #841/#862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlRunLog by GUID.' Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant etl841-applyetlmodels-runlog-tenantfilter-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
